card.name: Separator just before a number
card.fires_on: The colon, slash, space or "to" that sits right before the next number in a dose, dilution, ratio or range. The next number is often a round figure such as 10, 20, 50 or 100.

modes.label: Dilution ratio colon
modes.description: The colon in a 1:N dilution, just before the second number.

modes.label: Space before a dose
modes.description: A space before a dose number after a drug name or a dose range.

modes.label: Slash or "to" in a range
modes.description: A slash or "to" linking two doses or a range.
modes.example: The maximum daily dosage is 200 mcg<</>>20 mcg.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward a round number next (such as 10, 20, 50 or 100) and away from words like "over".
card.plain: It fires on the gap or symbol just before the second number in a dose, ratio or range.
